the NBA was founded on June 6, 1946, in New York City, originally under the name Basketball Association of America (BAA). It was created by owners of major arenas who wanted to fill their venues with professional basketball games. The BAA played its first season in 1946, with the Philadelphia Warriors winning the first championship. In 1949, the BAA merged with the rival National Basketball League (NBL) and became the National Basketball Association (NBA).
